summary.content:
Today's selection covers 47 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 30 on Artificial Intelligence and 9 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: UK banks blocked from cyber AI tool Mythos get offer from rival OpenAI
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Critical Windows Netlogon RCE flaw now exploited in attacks
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, BleepingComputer, The Verge, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 15 articles published in the last 24 hours
